note: What a server sends to light up part of the screen, or to put it out. The header carries zero.

fields.name: part
fields.note: Which part of the screen. A client also acts on 2, taking element, number and unused as three values; what that lights up is not recorded. A client ignores any other value.

1.name: hud
1.note: The main controls, with element and number as in HudHighlighted.

3.name: minimap
3.note: The minimap; a client acts only where element is 0, its camera button, and number and unused have no effect.

fields.name: element
fields.note: What to light up, as in HudHighlighted. A value beyond those named does nothing.

fields.name: number
fields.note: Which slot, as in HudHighlighted.

fields.name: unused
fields.note: A third value where part is 2; a server writes zero otherwise.

fields.name: state

bits.name: on
bits.note: Set to light it up, clear to put it out.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client ignores these bits; a server writes zero.

fields.note: Whether it is lit.

fields.name: part
fields.note: Which part of the screen. A client ignores any other value.

2.name: shop
2.note: A shop element blinks or stops, where the shop window is open. A client takes only elements 0 to 4. Element 0 is the buy button, 1 the sell button, 2 the shop item number names, 3 the item second names within the category number names, and 4 the recommended item number names.

3.name: minimap
3.note: The minimap; a client acts on element 0 only, its camera button.
